target.workload: Qwen3.5-0.8B native F32 prefill plus decode
target.kernel: W8 symmetric group-64 tied lm_head top-4
target.production_selection: native F32 rerank over four Metal candidates

candidate_scope.materialization: candidate bytes are passed directly to command-v1 and written only inside its private scratch workspace

execution.candidate_installation: outer KerSor only after Host acceptance
execution.current_host_snapshot_includes: prefill_token_for_generation hook and every other current non-candidate source byte
execution.cancellation: SIGINT, SIGTERM, command timeout, and output overflow terminate the complete private child process group
execution.stream_limits: stdout and stderr are each bounded in real time to 2097152 bytes

correctness.model_path: required absolute external Host input; exact Qwen3.5-0.8B config and every direct file are hashed at start and end

performance.baseline_candidate_relation: two isolated builds from one frozen Host snapshot; the only source difference is the shader hash

quiet_host_gate.failure: retain the block and request a complete replacement schedule

performance.contamination_policy: retain all collected samples and return replacement_required; never delete or relabel them
performance.trajectory_gate: every formal sample must match the accepted 100-token native-F32 trajectory

custody.workflow_artifacts: host_evaluator.py and host_contract.json SHA-256 pinned by the workflow
custody.model: exact direct-file manifest and Qwen3.5-0.8B identity must match at start and end
custody.sources: baseline/candidate source manifests must match at start, after correctness gates, and at evaluation end
custody.toolchain: cargo and rustc executable SHA-256 identities must match at start and end
custody.schedule_retry: replacement_required may expose candidate bytes plus SHA-256 for one same-bytes remeasurement; retry skips Agent and cannot mutate the candidate

receipt.workflow_admission: exact keys and cross-field identities are checked for command-v1 confinement, platform, snapshot, five ordered gates, two builds, execution path, custody, and preserved performance blocks
receipt.accepted_shape: exactly 24 samples in six complete ABBA/BAAB blocks, six block wins, at least 1.10x median generation throughput, all guardrails and custody checks passing
receipt.replacement_shape: correctness and custody passed, candidate is not best, contamination is retained, and only source plus Host candidate SHA-256 may be returned for same-bytes remeasurement

positive: candidate binary contains the exact candidate shader bytes
execution_path_evidence.negative_control: the same candidate binary without --metal-w8-lm-head reports false while producing the same native-F32 token
